The release of the highly controversial Bitcoin XT client sent the Bitcoin price tanking.

The inglorious Bitcoin fork introduces major changes to the Bitcoin code like increasing the blocksize and censoring IP addresses and left some of the high-profile bitcoin advocates asking if even the hard coded limit of 21 mn currency units may be increased in the future.

As investors get nervous and uncertainty raises Bitcoin sold off hard across all exchanges with price hitting 162.00 USD on Bitfinex in a spectacular flash crash. The price on Bitstamp fell down to as low as 221.11 USD on the day.

The volatility is back

The uncertainties about Bitcoin's future have sent the BTCVOL (Bitcoin Volatility Index) higher.

BTCVOL spiking higher. Source: Btcvol.info

The last time the 30-day volatility rose above 2.5 was in November 2014. This put downward pressure on Bitcoin price which consecutively plunged lower by over 50%.

The volatility can continue to rise. This could result in Bitcoin price breaking it's January lows and heading lower.

Nothing goes up or down in a straight line

Since Bitcoin broke out of the short-term upward trend we've seen continuous downward momentum with the 3-day RSI hitting the 35 mark and now hanging just above it. Most likely we will see a bounce from here which will provide an opportunity to short the BTCUSD.

BTCUSD breaking key support levels. Source: Bitcoinwisdom.com

The favorable levels for establishing a short position are in the 250.00-278.00 USD range. The projected bottom would be at the 90% retracement from Bitstamp's January lows of 152.40 USD to July highs of 317.99 USD which puts our short-term target at ~170.00 USD.
